notes: Recorded 52 bachelor majors (professional degrees such as Pharmacy, Medicine and Doctor of Dental Medicine included as the page lists them as majors) from the Academic Programs table, which shows 86 entries in total: 52 majors (120 to 190 credit hours) and 34 minors (15 to 24 credit hours). Minors are not recorded because the scholarship is for bachelor's majors.

Majors per college: College of Arts and Sciences 16; College of Business and Economics 6; College of Dental Medicine 1; College of Education 5; College of Engineering 9; College of Health Sciences 5; College of Law 1; College of Medicine 1; College of Nursing 1; College of Pharmacy 1; College of Sharia and Islamic Studies 4; College of Sport Sciences 2. The page's own college counts include minors (for example Arts and Sciences 35 entries).

Entry requirements for Fall 2027 (75% high school percentage for most colleges, 80% Pharmacy, 90% Medicine and Dental Medicine; English and mathematics tests for Health Sciences, Nursing, Pharmacy, Medicine and Dental Medicine) are on the same page; the scholarship itself needs a 95% high school average.

Some majors are shown for female students only (for example Sociology, Psychology, Physics, Industrial and Systems Engineering and Architecture); the gender flags are the page's legend (F, M, F/M) and are recorded in the detail text.
The page lists general majors only: concentrations inside Secondary Education and Mass Communication are flagged but not itemised on the page read.
not_stated: Which majors are open to international scholarship applicants for the Fall 2027 intake specifically; the page lists programmes and admission percentages but no per-major scholarship quotas.
Duration for some majors (Nursing, Speech and Language Pathology): the table leaves it blank.
